en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large villa named "Waldidylle" in a rural forested setting near Oberbärenburg. The image features a fenced property with a multi‑storey house with balconies on the right and another smaller building on the left, surrounded by tall conifer trees and a dirt path in the foreground. German text is printed in red at the top and bottom of the card.
